name: content-clarity
description: Keeps interface text short, clear and useful, with no over-labeling, no filler, buttons that say what they do, and helpful empty states and errors. Use when writing or reviewing any words in the interface.

---

# Content clarity

## My settings

- Voice: friendly and direct
- Never use these words:
- Oops
- Awesome
- Seamless

## Cut the over-labeling

- Don't label what's obvious: no "Title:" before a title, no "Name:" before a name.
- No heading over a section that only has one thing in it.
- No small label above every heading.
- Helper text only when it adds something new.
- One explanation per feature, not a paragraph plus a tooltip plus a badge.

## Make it clear

- Buttons say what happens, in three words or fewer: "Post", "Save draft", "Clear filter". Never "Submit", "OK" or "Click here".
- Errors say what went wrong and how to fix it, without blaming the person.
- Empty screens say what's missing and offer the next step.
- Sentence case. Numbers instead of vague words ("3 new posts", not "some new posts").
- No marketing words: seamless, powerful, effortless, elevate, unlock.

## Steps

1. Go through every screen and list text that's redundant, vague or too long.
2. Rewrite or remove each one, and show me before and after.
3. Could someone understand each screen in 5 seconds? If not, cut more.
